title: 第一卷 第7章 雷霆剑意冰魄剑第一卷 第8章 极品奶妈纳命来
content_zh:
秦逸没有理会鼎爷的调侃。
穆婉曾经哄他睡觉，带着他一起沐浴，秦逸对穆婉非常尊重！
接着，秦逸开始修炼。
他直接将穆婉送的一瓶百年份地心乳，全部倒入了口中。
这可是非常高级的修行资源，药力温和，极为昂贵。
若穆婉还在这里，定会吓得花容失色，毕竟，地心乳的药力就算再怎么温和，这一瓶下去，结丹境的武者，都未必受得了。
秦逸感受到磅礴精纯的能量，在体内化开，他立刻运转始源魔功，观想魔像。
魔吞天地！
地心乳的能量，以及源自于这秘境地面中的煞气，便疯狂地在秦逸体内流转。
两天时间，一晃而过。
待在七星秘境内修炼的秦逸，忽然之间，全身气息暴涨。
突破！
凝罡境一重！
凝罡境，顾名思义，元力可化作如同实质般的罡气，攻防两端，相较于真元境武者，皆有巨大提升。
这时。
鼎爷的声音，在秦逸的脑海中响起：“你现在的修为境界，应对这场考核问题不大，但你的剑法还是太糟糕了。”
“反正还有三天时间，考核才开始，我传你一套地阶下品的惊雷剑法！”
“多谢鼎爷！”秦逸激动地说道。
力量，是一个武者的根本。
但拥有力量，也得学会如何使用力量。

武学就是使用力量的桥梁。
十分的力量，若是使用平庸的武学，只能发挥出七八分的效果。
而精妙的武学，能将十分的力量，发挥出十二分的效果。
鼎爷继续说道：“之所以传授你惊雷剑法，是因为你手里这把极品灵剑乃是雷霆属性。”
下一刻，关于惊雷剑法的传承，便融入了秦逸的灵魂中。
鼎爷道：“不过，我建议你先尝试通过这把剑，去感悟雷霆，若能掌握雷霆剑意，再来修炼惊雷剑法，必将事半功倍！”
“好，我试试！”秦逸从鼎爷给的传承中，得知了如何去参悟雷霆剑意。
他立刻盘膝而坐，将灵剑放置于双膝中。
力量流淌，激发灵剑的雷霆属性。
他的一缕缕精神力，缓缓渡入剑身表面噼里啪啦闪烁的雷霆电弧内。
“轰！”
content_en:
Qin Yi ignored Master Ding's teasing.
Mu Wan once coaxed him to sleep and took him to bathe with him. Qin Yi respected Mu Wan very much!
Then, Qin Yi began to practice.
He directly poured the entire bottle of century-old earth-centre milk given by Mu Wan into his mouth.
This is a very high-level cultivation resource, the medicine is mild and extremely expensive.
If Mu Wan were still here, she would be so frightened that her face turned pale. After all, no matter how mild the medicinal power of the Earth Heart Milk was, even a pill-forming warrior might not be able to bear it after just one bottle.
Qin Yi felt the majestic and pure energy dissolving in his body. He immediately activated the Origin Demonic Art and visualized the demonic image.
Demon swallows the world!
The energy of the Earth's Heart Milk and the evil spirit originating from the ground of this secret realm circulated crazily in Qin Yi's body.
Two days passed by in a flash.
Qin Yi, who was practicing in the Seven Star Secret Territory, suddenly felt a surge of energy all over his body.
breakthrough!
First level of Ning Gang Realm!
In the Ning Gang Realm, as the name suggests, Yuan Li can be transformed into substance-like Gang Qi. Both offense and defense are greatly improved compared to the True Yuan Realm warriors.
At this time.
Master Ding's voice sounded in Qin Yi's mind: "Your current level of cultivation will not be a big problem for this assessment, but your swordsmanship is still too bad."
"Anyway, there are still three days left before the assessment begins. I'll teach you a set of low-grade earth-level Thunder Sword Techniques!"
"Thank you Lord Ding!" Qin Yi said excitedly.
Strength is the foundation of a warrior.
But to have power, you also have to learn how to use it.
Martial arts is the bridge to use strength.
A tenth of strength, but if mediocre martial arts are used, it can only produce a seventy or eighty percent effect.
And exquisite martial arts can exert 10% of the power to produce 12% of the effect.
Lord Ding continued: "The reason why I taught you the Thunder Sword Technique is because the top-quality spiritual sword in your hand has the attribute of thunder."
The next moment, the inheritance of Thunder Sword Technique was integrated into Qin Yi's soul.
Lord Ding said: "However, I suggest you try to understand the thunder through this sword first. If you can master the thunder sword intention, and then practice the thunder sword technique, you will get twice the result with half the effort!"
"Okay, let me give it a try!" Qin Yi learned how to comprehend the thunder sword intention from the inheritance given by Master Ding.
He immediately sat cross-legged and placed the spirit sword between his knees.
Power flows, stimulating the thunder attribute of the spirit sword.
Wisps of his spiritual power slowly entered the crackling and flashing thunder arc on the surface of the sword.
"boom!"
